in_sanskrit.name: सहदेव्य
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who accompanies the Devas or divine beings

in_marathi.name: Sahadevya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sahadevya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from Sahadeva, the twin brother of Nakula in the epic Mahabharata, known for his wisdom and loyalty.

in_bengali.name: Sahadevya
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God's companion
in_bengali.long_meaning: Sahadevya একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from Sahadeva, the twin brother of Nakula in the epic Mahabharata, known for his wisdom and loyalty.
